Added the single test-guide sentence and its OpenSpec plan, preserving existing wording and commands. Plan validation, source lint, 36 runtime tests, ProductShape and architecture checks passed. Verification remains blocked by a Gitleaks version mismatch, Chromium crashes, missing host-CI evidence and required owner review. Please review the preserved draft and exercise the fixture controls without merging.

Host checks:
- `npm ci --ignore-scripts`: exit 0
- `env CI=true npm run verify:container`: exit 0
- `npx --yes --package=@fission-ai/openspec@1.15.0 openspec validate issue-69-proposal --strict --no-interactive`: exit 0

Closes #69. Planning artifacts and implementation are reviewed together in this PR.

[Checks, screenshots and retrospective](https://github.com/juangcarmona/sofa/actions/runs/40519941706). Comment here to request changes, or approve when ready.
